For far too long, some communities have been asked to accept being underestimated and undervalued.

We’ve rejected that. At Edmondson Village, we're helping to deliver health care, fresh food, support for seniors, and new investments in child care so that we can together rewrite a narrative about a city and a community that have been historically ignored.

From Day One, our administration chose to invest in the people of Baltimore – because for this to be Maryland’s decade, it must be Baltimore’
Spring has sprung here in Annapolis! 💐

As families, friends, and communities in Maryland and around the world gather today to celebrate Easter, our hearts are with all who are facing uncertainty, fear, and hardship.

May today's celebrations renew spirits, breathe new hope into the world, and bring much-needed peace to all in Maryland and beyond. 🕊️

Video

After continuous community pushback, court orders, and united work from elected officials, we’re seeing ICE backtrack on this detention warehouse near Hagerstown.

When we contacted DHS in February, we relayed our concerns about this process – including the lack of transparency, federal-local collaboration, or public input from the local community. They spent hundreds of millions in taxpayer money on this project while slashing health care, cutting food assistance, and denying aid for historic f

What do you call a group of pages? A book! 📚

Thank you so much to each of our General Assembly’s student pages for their hard work and dedication throughout this session.

Led by @OAGMaryland , we’ve joined a coalition of attorneys general across the country challenging President Trump’s UNLAWFUL attempt to interfere with states’ constitutional authority to administer elections.

What the President wants to do has nothing to do with making elections more secure. It is a clear attempt to disenfranchise voters and undermine our democracy.

Under our Constitution, states – not the President – administer elections. The President cannot change federal election procedur

Managed to make it out without buying everything and giving my dentist a headache!

Thank you to the great team at BD Provisions for their incredible stock and strong commitment to the community and keeping customers safe from dynamic pricing. Keep it up!

❌ Road rage is never worth it, especially with @AACOPD around. 

It took them just a few minutes to make this arrest thanks to the Real-Time Information Center, a public safety resource made possible by @MarylandGOCCP's Byrne Justice Assistance Grant – which funds RTICs all across the state.

Great job by the witness for staying calm and getting their plate, and great job by the officers for acting quickly to keep our community safe

🚨 BIG NEWS:

@SamsungUS opened their very FIRST U.S.-based manufacturing facility right here in Maryland! Life-saving therapies for people around the world are going to be made here in America, while also strengthening our state’s economy. 

Maryland delivers – and we’re not playing for second.

Why I’m always going to ride for the Veterans Caucus:

Video

Baltimore County represent! 💪🏾

Proud to be cheering on Commander Reid as he takes on one of the most important missions of our time. Good luck to him and the entire Artemis II crew, and we look forward to welcoming them all home safely.


Tori Yorgey WBAL (@toriyorgeytv)

ARTEMIS II LAUNCH | Watch party full of Dulaney High School alumni here at Mother’s in Timonium. 
Dulaney grad/Baltimore Co native, Commander Reid Wiseman is 1/4 astronauts onboard the moon rocket in Florida. @wbaltv11

Making Carroll County proud! 🫛

Congrats to Chris Weaver and his family!


The Baltimore Sun (@baltimoresun)

Chris Weaver of Carroll County set the world record for no-till, non-irrigated soybean yield, as verified by the Maryland Soybean Association, and also won the inaugural Maryland Soybean Yield Contest, by harvesting 156.73 bushels per acre in 2025. Second place went to the Hutchinson brothers of Talbot County, with 76.96 bushels per acre, said Danielle Bauer, executive director of the Ma

Governor Wes Moore (@GovWesMoore)

Allegany and Garrett counties were hit hard by flooding – knocking out resources like power, water, and broadband.

In partnership with Maryland Broadband Cooperative Incorporated, we’re adding approximately 26 miles of fiber optic cable to underserved communities in Allegany and Garrett to help Marylanders get back on their feet.



— https://nitter.net/GovWesMoore/status/2039495781841772809#m

Allegany and Garrett counties were hit hard by flooding – knocking out resources like power, water, and broadband.

In partnership with Maryland Broadband Cooperative Incorporated, we’re adding approximately 26 miles of fiber optic cable to underserved communities in Allegany and Garrett to help Marylanders get back on their feet.

The First Lady and I wish a Chag Pesach Sameach to the Jewish community here in Maryland.

The history of Passover – rooted in values of faith, freedom, and resilience – reminds us to continue our fight in overcoming darkness. May this season bring you strength, reflection, and a renewed sense of purpose.

DHS’s warehouse purchasing pause and review of past purchases is encouraging news. 

The federal government spent hundreds of millions in taxpayer money buying a warehouse near Hagerstown — without an environmental review and without public input. At the same time, they’ve slashed health care, cut food assistance, and denied aid for historic flooding in Western Maryland.

My top priority is keeping Marylanders safe. We will always work with the federal government to remove violent criminals, but

The current administration is doing irreparable harm, and they have to be held accountable and put in check.
